bounded_question: What does the getter-shaped function at 0x5eeb9c0 compute end to end, given that it dispatches on a decimal text view through the parser at 0x61d0df0 instead of returning a field?
by_contract: The parser's 9 other direct call sites are sites only; their callers are not read and only this caller's use is modelled.
The group's element type is not identified; only the byte-span arithmetic (span >> 3, i.e. 8-byte elements) is claimed.
The outer class and any meaning of the [outer + 0x778] bound beyond the index check are not claimed.
Negative 32-bit indices and indices naming no group raise ValueError in the model; the binary would read out of bounds there. Both guards are model-only.
